title: Send from four threads to one through a bounded channel
summary: Four producer threads each send 250 to 4,000 small integers through one bounded channel of capacity 1, 16 or 1,024 to a single consumer thread, which checks that each producer's messages arrive in order and adds them up.
notes: A task on five threads: four producers and the consumer. CPU time is the sum over all threads, so a channel that spins while it waits pays for the spinning, and wall-clock time is not what is ranked. Each operation starts its four producer threads and joins them; starting them is part of the figure. Go runs with GOMAXPROCS=5. CPython and CRuby run one thread at a time under their interpreter lock, so their threads take turns rather than run in parallel. No JavaScript entry: these are channels between threads.
